title: Adventure Mindset by Jits into the Sunset
author: Tania & Adam
description: Welcome! We're Tania and Adam, travel filmmakers living in our campervan, Jits, or out of our backpacks. We host in-depth conversations with inspirational people who have chosen an alternative lifestyle. Beyond travel, adventure and roadtrips, we discuss courage, personal growth, mental health and mindset. Expect thought-provoking conversations that encourage and empower you to follow your own adventure, whatever adventure means to you. New Episodes every Sunday!
